caption: The drawing features a single object composed of cast iron, depicted in three separate views: a perspective view, a top view, and a side view. The object is shaped roughly like an elongated teardrop or the sole of a shoe, with a rounded handle extending from one end. The interior of the object consists of a network of curved, intersecting bars forming irregularly-shaped openings. The object stands on three short, cylindrical legs. The color of the drawing uses shades of gray to illustrate the metallic texture and shadows, suggesting a dark, heavy material like iron. A small linear scale is included below the side view for measurement reference. The drawing is signed in the bottom left corner with the name "I. SOVENSKY." The background is a light beige, and the composition is orderly, with each view of the object arranged for clear visualization.
title: Flat Iron Holder
